defs.def: to place a dead body in a grave 埋葬；安葬

ex.s: Soon after the quakes, the army sent 150,000 soldiers to Tangshan to dig out those who were trapped and to bury the dead.
ex.t: 地震后不久，军队派出15万名士兵前往唐山，挖出被困者并掩埋遇难者。

defs.def: to lose sb by death 丧失（某人）
to hide sth in the ground 把（某物）掩藏在地下；埋藏

ex.s: When these organisms die，they bury carbon in the deep ocean，an important process that helps to regulate the global climate.
ex.t: 当这些生物死亡时，它们把碳埋入深海，这一重要过程有助于调节全球气候。

ex.s: Based on this, he believed he had spotted an unknown Maya city buried deep in the jungle.
ex.t: 基于此，他相信自己发现了一座深埋丛林、不为人知的玛雅古城。

ex.s: These may sometimes include whole cities buried beneath the waves.
ex.t: 这些有时可能包括整座沉没于波涛之下的城市。

ex.s: Believed to have been buried underwater by a tsunami in the fourth century AD, the ruins of Neápolis are almost 2,000 years old.
ex.t: 尼阿波利斯遗址据信在公元4世纪被一场海啸淹没于水下，其历史已近2000年。

ex.s: By comparison, he discovered that the locations of the 117 known Maya cities match the positions of the stars, and he believed he had found the exact position of an unknown Maya city buried deep in the jungle.
ex.t: 相比之下，他发现已知的117座玛雅古城的位置与星辰的位置吻合，并相信自己找到了那座深埋丛林、不为人知的玛雅古城的确切位置。

defs.def: to cover sb/sth with soil, rocks, leaves, etc. （以土、石、树叶等）覆盖
to cover sth so that it cannot be seen 遮盖；掩盖
to ignore or hide a feeling, a mistake, etc. 不顾，掩藏（感情、错误等）
to put sth deeply into sth else 使陷入，把 … 插入（某物）
to give all your attention to sth 专心致志于某事
to go to or be in a place where you will not meet many people 隐居
